device.description: Octal 16-bit voltage-output DAC with 2.5-V internal reference, 32-bit SPI write, LDAC and CLR
device.note: dac7568.pdf (SBAS430F) p.3 device comparison (grades, reset to zero/midscale), p.4 pin configuration and functions (TSSOP-16), p.7-8 timing requirements and Figure 1 (data on SCLK falling edges, SCLK idles high), p.33-34 serial interface (32-bit frame, update on the 32nd falling SCLK, SYNC interrupt), p.35 input register format (Tables 1-3), p.36-38 control matrix (Table 4), p.39 SYNC interrupt, power-on reset, clear code register and CLR, software reset (Tables 5-6), p.44-45 internal reference modes, p.45-46 LDAC functionality, p.47 power-down modes (Table 13)

protocol.note: 32-bit frame: DB31 = 0, DB30-DB28 don't care, C3-C0, A3-A0, 16 data bits from DB19, then ignored bits and F3-F0; decoded on the 32nd SCLK falling edge without waiting for SYNC high (commit now); SYNC high before the 31st edge discards the frame; further clocks ignored

pages: p.3 (grades), p.4 (pins), p.5-7 (AVDD 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs to AVDD + 0.3 V), p.7-8 (timing, Figure 1), p.33-38 (serial interface, Tables 1-4), p.39 (SYNC interrupt, power-on reset, clear code, software reset), p.44-47 (reference, LDAC, power-down)
notModeled: analog outputs, internal 2.5-V reference and power-down output loads (reference and power-down commands stored only in REF / PD; outputs never driven)
power-down command applies its mode only to the channels whose mask bit is 1; the model stores the last command's mode and mask (PD), not a per-channel state
clear code 11 (ignore the CLR pin) has no clear code in the model's map: the pin is not disabled

CLR is falling-edge triggered and the device stays in clear mode until the 32nd SCLK of the next write, and a CLR during a write aborts it; the model loads the clear code once on the falling edge and does not abort the write
LDAC register: channels with their bit set ignore the LDAC pin and update on the 32nd SCLK (stored only; every channel follows the LDAC pin)
invalid channel codes A3 = 1 other than 1111 and reserved control codes 1010-1111 (no command matches: the frame is ignored); DB31 = 1 frames are ignored likewise
SYNC kept low after the 32nd clock: the shift register stays locked until SYNC rises and falls again (fixed frame: same result)
pin inputs at AVDD + 0.3 V max; no SDO / read-back on this device
variants: dac7568.pdf covers DAC7568 (12-bit, data DB19-DB8), DAC8168 (14-bit, DB19-DB6) and DAC8568 (16-bit, DB19-DB4); same pins and commands. Grades A/C power on to zero scale, B/D to midscale (DAC8568 only has B/D). A TSSOP-14 package (no LDAC/CLR, e.g. DAC8168IAPW) is not in the parts list.
